questions.stem_text: Rewrite the sentence keeping the original meaning: A mechanic repaired my father's motorbike yesterday. (HAD)
options: My father had a mechanic to repair his motorbike yesterday.
My father had his motorbike repaired yesterday.
My father had his motorbike repair yesterday.
My father got his motorbike repair yesterday.
written_answers: My father had his motorbike repaired yesterday.
questions.explanation_vi: Câu viết lại chuẩn: My father had his motorbike repaired yesterday.

questions.stem_text: Rewrite the sentence keeping the original meaning: The barber cut Mai's hair on Monday. (HAD)
options: Mai had her hair cut on Monday.
Mai had her hair cutted on Monday.
Mai had the barber to cut her hair on Monday.
Mai had her hair to cut on Monday.
written_answers: Mai had her hair cut on Monday.
questions.explanation_vi: Câu viết lại chuẩn: Mai had her hair cut on Monday.

written_answers: We got our friends to help us.
questions.explanation_vi: Câu viết lại chuẩn: We got our friends to help us.

questions.stem_text: Find and correct the mistake: I had my sister <u>to check</u> my essay.
written_answers: I had my sister check my essay.
questions.explanation_vi: to check → check (I had my sister check my essay.) | Quy tắc: have somebody + V (bare infinitive), not to V.

questions.stem_text: Find and correct the mistake: He got his bicycle <u>repair</u> at the shop.
written_answers: He got his bicycle repaired at the shop.
questions.explanation_vi: repair → repaired (He got his bicycle repaired at the shop.) | Quy tắc: get something + V3/ed (past participle).

questions.stem_text: Find and correct the mistake: We got the driver <u>wait</u> outside.
written_answers: We got the driver to wait outside.
questions.explanation_vi: wait → to wait (We got the driver to wait outside.) | Quy tắc: get somebody + to V.

questions.stem_text: Find and correct the mistake: She had her dress <u>make</u> by a tailor.
written_answers: She had her dress made by a tailor.
questions.explanation_vi: make → made (She had her dress made by a tailor.) | Quy tắc: have something + V3/ed (made).

questions.stem_text: Find and correct the mistake: The coach had the team <u>to practise</u> after school.
written_answers: The coach had the team practise after school.
questions.explanation_vi: to practise → practise (The coach had the team practise after school.) | Quy tắc: have somebody + V (bare infinitive).

questions.stem_text: Find and correct the mistake: My parents got our living room <u>paint</u> last weekend.
written_answers: My parents got our living room painted last weekend.
questions.explanation_vi: paint → painted (My parents got our living room painted last weekend.) | Quy tắc: get something + V3/ed (painted).

questions.stem_text: Find and correct the mistake: Our teacher got <u>we</u> to tidy the classroom.
written_answers: Our teacher got us to tidy the classroom.
questions.explanation_vi: we → us (Our teacher got us to tidy the classroom.) | Quy tắc: use object pronoun 'us' after got.

questions.stem_text: Find and correct the mistake: She had her brother <u>fixed</u> the bike.
written_answers: She had her brother fix the bike.
questions.explanation_vi: fixed → fix (She had her brother fix the bike.) | Quy tắc: have somebody + V (fix, active causative).

remember_patterns: GET / HAVE + something + V3/ed (past participle — passive causative)
